lines.zh: 伞盖一开一合，我往上漂。
lines.en: My bell opens and closes; I drift upward.

lines.zh: 满月的光落下来，我亮得更蓝。
lines.en: Full-moon light falls, and I glow a deeper blue.

lines.zh: 洋流推着我，我不必用力。
lines.en: The current carries me; I need no effort.

lines.zh: 我身上的刺，是给碰我的人看的。
lines.en: My spines are a warning to anyone who touches me.

lines.zh: 白天海面太亮，我在深处发光。
lines.en: By day the surface blazes; I light my own way below.

lines.zh: 被钓上来时，我还在发光。
lines.en: Even hauled up on a hook, I keep glowing.

lines.zh: 我漂过礁石，刺没有碰到它。
lines.en: I drift past the reef without a spine touching it.

lines.zh: 五格深的水里，蓝得看不清我。
lines.en: At five blocks deep, the blue hides me completely.

lines.zh: 我从来不上岸，岸边太干。
lines.en: I never go ashore; the shore is far too dry.

lines.zh: 这条海流，我跟着走了很久。
lines.en: I have followed this current for a long while.

lines.zh: 我的身体轻得像一片光。
lines.en: My body is as light as a scrap of light.

lines.zh: 有人在下面看我，我就亮一下。
lines.en: When someone watches from below, I flash once.

lines.zh: 满月那晚的海，比平时更蓝。
lines.en: The sea on a full-moon night runs bluer than usual.

lines.zh: 我一收伞盖，就往下沉一点。
lines.en: When I close my bell, I sink a little.

lines.zh: 我的刺撑开，把水拨慢一些。
lines.en: I spread my spines and slow the water a little.

lines.zh: 礁石上面太亮，我往下挪。
lines.en: The reef top is too bright, so I drift lower.

lines.zh: 一条小鱼蹭过来，被刺退了。
lines.en: A small fish brushes by and the spines fend it off.

lines.zh: 我漂过一段沙脊，没有影子。
lines.en: I drift over a sand ridge without casting a shadow.

lines.zh: 我停在水里，只让触手随波摆动。
lines.en: I hang in the water, letting my tentacles wave with the tide.

lines.zh: 光从伞盖里慢慢透出来。
lines.en: Light seeps slowly out through my bell.

lines.zh: 这片海很安静，我连刺都收着。
lines.en: This sea is quiet; I even keep my spines folded.

lines.zh: 我在等满月再亮一次。
lines.en: I am waiting for the full moon to shine once more.

lines.zh: 没有骨头，我也能漂一整天。
lines.en: With no bones, I can drift an entire day.

lines.zh: 水流带着我，我不挑方向。
lines.en: The water carries me, and I have no preference.

lines.zh: 我的刺竖着，其实没什么力气。
lines.en: My spines are raised, though they have little strength.

lines.zh: 一点盐味，就够我醒着。
lines.en: A taste of salt is enough to keep me awake.

lines.zh: 我在数水面上有多少颗星。
lines.en: I am counting how many stars sit on the surface.

lines.zh: 蓝色淡下来，我快要睡了。
lines.en: My blue is fading; I am nearly asleep.

lines.zh: 海底的沙子，比我的光更凉。
lines.en: The seabed sand is colder than my glow.

lines.zh: 我轻轻一震，惊起一圈小鱼。
lines.en: One soft pulse and a ring of small fish scatters.

lines.zh: 漂着的时候，时间没有意义。
lines.en: While drifting, time means nothing at all.

lines.zh: 我把自己收成一团，省点光。
lines.en: I gather myself into a ball to save some light.

lines.zh: 你潜下来了，光会不会刺眼？
lines.en: You have dived down; does my glow sting your eyes?

lines.zh: 别用手抓，我的刺不长眼。
lines.en: Don't grab with your hands; my spines don't aim.

lines.zh: 你身上的火把，比月亮还亮。
lines.en: That torch on you burns brighter than the moon.

lines.zh: 我看不清你的脸，只看到影子。
lines.en: I can't make out your face, only your shadow.

lines.zh: 你钓了我多久，才等到这一晚？
lines.en: How many nights did you fish before I came?

lines.zh: 我的光晃了一下，是在看你。
lines.en: My light flickered once — that was me looking at you.

lines.zh: 你在水里待不久，我知道。
lines.en: You can't stay down here long; I know that.

lines.zh: 别靠太近，我会麻到你。
lines.en: Not too close — I might numb you.

lines.zh: 你的网，我不喜欢。
lines.en: Your net — I don't care for it.

lines.zh: 你走了以后，海还是很安静。
lines.en: After you leave, the sea stays just as quiet.

lines.zh: 刺被撞歪了，我缩起伞盖。
lines.en: A spine is bent; I pull my bell in.

lines.zh: 我的光闪了几下才稳住。
lines.en: My light flickers a few times before steadying.

lines.zh: 疼，可我的刺还竖着。
lines.en: It hurts, but my spines stay up.

lines.zh: 壳上多了一道裂，光漏出来。
lines.en: A crack has opened and my light leaks out.

lines.zh: 我被撞得往下沉了一格。
lines.en: The blow sank me down a block.

lines.zh: 水里散开一点蓝，是我的光。
lines.en: A little blue spreads in the water — my own glow.

lines.zh: 越疼，我亮得越厉害。
lines.en: The more it hurts, the harder I burn.

lines.zh: 我慢慢飘开，避开下一次。
lines.en: I drift away slowly, avoiding the next one.

lines.zh: 身体软，可壳很硬。
lines.en: My body is soft, but the shell is hard.

lines.zh: 这点伤，满月能养回来。
lines.en: A wound like this heals by the next full moon.

lines.zh: 那点光在动，我朝它漂过去。
lines.en: That little light is moving; I drift toward it.

lines.zh: 饵上的亮片，像满月碎在水里。
lines.en: The lure's glitter looks like a full moon broken in water.

lines.zh: 我不吃东西，可我还是想靠近。
lines.en: I don't eat, yet I still want to come nearer.

lines.zh: 这晚的水，甜得有点奇怪。
lines.en: Tonight the water tastes strangely sweet.

lines.zh: 月亮照着你，我就跟着你。
lines.en: The moon lights you, so I follow you.

lines.zh: 我不饿，只是被光牵着走。
lines.en: I'm not hungry; the light simply leads me on.

lines.zh: 再靠近一尺，我就要发亮了。
lines.en: One foot closer and I will start to shine.

lines.zh: 水面上的影子，一直在晃。
lines.en: The shadow on the surface keeps swaying.

lines.zh: 整片海都在等这一晚。
lines.en: The whole sea has been waiting for this night.

lines.zh: 我漂过去，刺却软了下来。
lines.en: I drift over, and my spines soften.

lines.zh: 软软地撞上你，我弹开了。
lines.en: I bump you softly and bounce away.

lines.zh: 对不起，我漂得没方向。
lines.en: Sorry — I drift with no sense of direction.

lines.zh: 我的刺碰到你了吗？快退开。
lines.en: Did my spines touch you? Move back quickly.

lines.zh: 这一撞，把我撞得转了个圈。
lines.en: That knock sent me spinning in a circle.

lines.zh: 水里没有墙，我却撞上了你。
lines.en: There are no walls in water, yet I hit you.

lines.zh: 你身上有鳞片的味道。
lines.en: You smell faintly of scales.

lines.zh: 我再飘远一点，免得扎到你。
lines.en: I will drift further off so I don't sting you.

lines.zh: 碰撞的时候，我的光闪了一下。
lines.en: My light flickered when we bumped together.

lines.zh: 这次是我没看清，水流太快。
lines.en: That was my fault; the current was too fast.

lines.zh: 贴着你的护甲，我停了一息。
lines.en: I rested one breath against your armor.

lines.zh: 另一团蓝光，也在慢慢张合。
lines.en: Another blue glow is opening and closing too.

lines.zh: 满月那晚，我们才认得出彼此。
lines.en: Only on the full-moon night do we know each other.

lines.zh: 两团光靠在一起，海就亮了。
lines.en: Two glows together and the whole sea lights up.

lines.zh: 你的刺很短，我的也是。
lines.en: Your spines are short; so are mine.

lines.zh: 我们绕着同一股洋流转圈。
lines.en: We circle the same current, round and round.

lines.zh: 别靠得太急，光会乱。
lines.en: Don't rush in; the light will scatter.

lines.zh: 这一晚，够我们亮很久。
lines.en: One night like this will keep us glowing a long while.

lines.zh: 我张合得慢一些，等你。
lines.en: I pulse a little slower, waiting for you.

lines.zh: 月亮走了，我们还在这里。
lines.en: The moon will leave; we will still be here.

lines.zh: 太稀有了，能遇见就不易。
lines.en: We're so very rare that meeting at all is a stroke of luck.

lines.zh: 水里那颗亮的东西，我托起来。
lines.en: I lift that bright thing up out of the water.

lines.zh: 我不用手，用触手卷住它。
lines.en: I have no hands; I coil a tentacle around it.

lines.zh: 沉下去的东西，我都收着。
lines.en: Whatever sinks down, I keep it.

lines.zh: 这点碎光，我要藏进伞盖里。
lines.en: This scrap of light goes inside my bell.

lines.zh: 浮起来的东西，正好漂到我面前。
lines.en: It floated up and drifted right to me.

lines.zh: 我不会掉，我用刺卡住它。
lines.en: I won't drop it; my spines hold it in place.

lines.zh: 捡来的光，比自己的更亮。
lines.en: Borrowed light shines brighter than my own.

lines.zh: 这枚东西，我挂在触手上。
lines.en: I hang this one from a tentacle.

lines.zh: 海底的东西，只有我留意。
lines.en: Only I notice what lies on the seabed.

lines.zh: 捡到了，可我不知道它叫什么。
lines.en: I've got it, though I don't know what it is.

lines.zh: 有东西碰了我的刺，我要麻它。
lines.en: Something touched my spines; I will numb it.

lines.zh: 那团黑影冲我来了。
lines.en: That dark shape is coming straight at me.

lines.zh: 被威胁的时候，我不会逃。
lines.en: When threatened, I do not flee.

lines.zh: 它抓住了我的触手。
lines.en: It has grabbed hold of my tentacles.

lines.zh: 水波乱了，我知道是谁。
lines.en: The ripples are wrong; I know who it is.

lines.zh: 这一下，我要让它动不了。
lines.en: This time I will leave it unable to move.

lines.zh: 它靠得越近，我的光越亮。
lines.en: The closer it comes, the brighter I burn.

lines.zh: 刺已经竖起来了。
lines.en: My spines are already raised.

lines.zh: 有人想把我装进桶里。
lines.en: Someone means to put me into a bucket.

lines.zh: 我盯住那只伸过来的手。
lines.en: I fix my gaze on that reaching hand.

lines.zh: 它还在犹豫，我的刺等得起。
lines.en: It still hesitates; my spines can wait.

lines.zh: 让它再近半格。
lines.en: Let it come half a block closer.

lines.zh: 我的光暗下来，装作无害。
lines.en: I dim my glow and pretend to be harmless.

lines.zh: 触手已经伸到它背后。
lines.en: A tentacle has already reached behind it.

lines.zh: 等它碰到我，就晚了。
lines.en: Once it touches me, it will be too late.

lines.zh: 水里没有声音，只有光。
lines.en: There is no sound in the water, only light.

lines.zh: 伞盖跟着它转，光一直照着。
lines.en: My bell turns with it, keeping my light on it.

lines.zh: 再亮一点，它就看不见别的了。
lines.en: A little brighter, and it will see nothing else.

lines.zh: 我的刺对准了它的手。
lines.en: My spines are aimed at its hand.

lines.zh: 这一晚，我不会先动手。
lines.en: Tonight I will not strike first.

lines.zh: 刺一碰，它就僵住了。
lines.en: One touch of my spines and it freezes.

lines.zh: 麻痹从触手传过去。
lines.en: The numbness travels down my tentacles.

lines.zh: 我不咬，我只是让它停下。
lines.en: I don't bite; I only make it stop.

lines.zh: 它挣了两下，动不了了。
lines.en: It struggles twice, then cannot move.

lines.zh: 我的光这时候最亮。
lines.en: This is when my light burns brightest.

lines.zh: 被抓住的那只手，会麻很久。
lines.en: The hand that grabbed me will stay numb a while.

lines.zh: 撞上来的是它，不是我。
lines.en: It rammed into me; I did not ram it.

lines.zh: 刺扎进去，又轻轻收回。
lines.en: My spines pierce, then draw back gently.

lines.zh: 水里安静了，只剩我的光。
lines.en: The water goes quiet, leaving only my glow.

lines.zh: 手伸过来，就别怪我的刺。
lines.en: You put your hand in; don't blame my spines.

lines.zh: 钓线一收，我从深水里出来了。
lines.en: The line pulls tight and I come up from the deep.

lines.zh: 满月当天，我才被带上来。
lines.en: Only on the full-moon day am I brought up.

lines.zh: 海水灌满我的伞盖，我醒了。
lines.en: Seawater fills my bell, and I wake.

lines.zh: 这里没有同类生我，我是被钓来的。
lines.en: None of my kind spawn here; I was fished up.

lines.zh: 四面都是蓝，我慢慢张开。
lines.en: Blue on every side; I open slowly.

lines.zh: 这里离海面五格，刚好。
lines.en: Five blocks below the surface — just right.

lines.zh: 我一亮，附近的鱼都退开了。
lines.en: I light up, and nearby fish back away.

lines.zh: 这么稀有的我，居然落在这里。
lines.en: Rare as I am, I have ended up right here.

lines.zh: 先漂一圈，认认这片海。
lines.en: First a slow drift, to learn this sea.

lines.zh: 谁把我放下的？水里还有钓线的味道。
lines.en: Who set me down? The water still smells of line.

lines.zh: 火在水面上烧，我的伞盖发皱。
lines.en: Fire burns on the surface and my bell wrinkles.

lines.zh: 我摔在干地上，光暗了一半。
lines.en: I land on dry ground and half my light goes out.

lines.zh: 离开水太久，我的触手贴在一起。
lines.en: Out of water too long, my tentacles stick together.

lines.zh: 一声炸响，我的刺全被震开。
lines.en: A blast scatters every one of my spines.

lines.zh: 一根尖东西穿过伞盖。
lines.en: Something sharp has passed straight through my bell.

lines.zh: 紫雾罩住我，光被压住了。
lines.en: Violet mist covers me and smothers my glow.

lines.zh: 没有东西可吃，我只好更暗一些。
lines.en: Nothing to feed on; I simply grow dimmer.

lines.zh: 雷电劈进海里，我的刺全亮了。
lines.en: Lightning strikes the sea and every spine lights up.

lines.zh: 下方没有水，我的光也照不到底。
lines.en: No water below; my light finds no bottom.
